raci_definitions.R: Responsible - The operational role executing the step.
raci_definitions.A: Accountable - The single role with ultimate approval and signoff authority.
raci_definitions.C: Consulted - Roles providing required inputs, reviews, or subject matter expertise.
raci_definitions.I: Informed - Roles notified of milestone completion or status changes.

daci_definitions.D: Driver - The lead role driving the decision, facilitating consensus, and managing momentum.
daci_definitions.A: Approver - The single role with explicit decision authority to approve or veto.
daci_definitions.C: Contributor - Roles with knowledge, voice, or deliverables consulted to form the recommendation.
daci_definitions.I: Informed - Roles notified after the decision or milestone is finalized.
